splash.seoDesc: Aurya gathers Italy’s holistic retreats in one curated place. We’re getting ready to launch: leave your email and be among the first.

splash.operatorText: Bring your retreats to Aurya: join now and be part of our founding group of practitioners.
splash.peek: Take a peek at the retreats preview

opNw.seoTitle: Your work deserves to be known | Aurya
opNw.seoDesc: Aurya tells the stories of wellbeing professionals through interviews and carefully written profiles. Join the network: your work deserves to be known.
opNw.heroTitle: Your work deserves to be known.
opNw.heroP1: Every day you walk beside people on their wellbeing journey.
opNw.heroP2: You bring study, experience, listening and presence.
opNw.heroP3: And yet, online, all of this often shrinks to a few lines and a list of services.
opNw.heroP4: Aurya was born to change that.
opNw.heroP5: We are building a network of professionals told with care, a space where people can get to know you before they choose you and where your digital presence can grow together with your work.
opNw.whyP1: The internet offers countless ways to be visible. But being visible does not mean being understood.
opNw.whyP2: We believe people choose a professional above all for how they work, for what they convey and for the trust they manage to create.
opNw.whyP3: This is why Aurya was not born as a directory. It was born to tell the story of people, to give value to their path and to build a network where content, professionals and experiences strengthen one another.
opNw.findTitle: A space that grows together with your work.
opNw.findIntro: By joining the network you will start building a digital presence made to accompany your work over time.
opNw.c1t: A profile that tells who you are
opNw.c1b: Not a record. A page built together with us that tells your approach, your path and the value of your work.
opNw.c2b: We interview you and turn your experience into a piece published on the Aurya Magazine. Because people more easily choose someone they have had the chance to know.
opNw.c3b: Your profile will be carried by the Magazine, the newsletter, our channels and search engines. Every piece of content helps make your work more visible too.
opNw.c4t: A space that will grow with you
opNw.c4b: In the coming months your profile will become more and more complete. You will be able to publish your services, receive booking requests, organise workshops, events and retreats, share a single link with everything you do and manage your presence in one place.
opNw.findCloseA: We are not simply building a platform.
opNw.findCloseB: We are building the digital space many wellbeing professionals have always wished for.
opNw.buildTitle: The first professionals will have a special role.
opNw.buildP1: Aurya is still at the beginning. This is why we want to build it together with the people who work in wellbeing every day.
opNw.buildP2: Your ideas, your needs and your experience will guide how the project evolves.
opNw.buildP3: Joining today means taking part in the birth of a network that will keep growing for years.
opNw.faq1a: Today joining the network has no cost. What we ask is the time of a conversation and the will to tell your work seriously.
opNw.faq2a: You write us a couple of lines about yourself. If there is a good feeling we talk and ask you a few questions. Then we write your profile in your own words and publish it together with your story.
opNw.faq3a: Because in this phase we build the value together: you bring your work and your experience, we bring the time to tell it and the channels to have it read. When the tools to manage services and bookings arrive we will talk about it clearly, with no surprises.
opNw.faq4q: When will the new features arrive?
opNw.faq4a: We are building them together with the first professionals who join. We decide the priorities by listening to them, and whoever is here from the start tries them first.
opNw.whoLine1: We are not a marketing agency.
opNw.whoLead: We are people who believe that wellbeing deserves a different space on the web.
opNw.formSubB: It is the beginning of a conversation.
opNw.endTitleA: Networks are not built in a day.
opNw.endTitleB: They are built one person at a time.
opNw.endBody: If you feel that Aurya also reflects your way of seeing wellbeing, we would love to meet you.

tr.seoTitle: Aurya | There is a retreat out there waiting for you
tr.seoDesc: Aurya is about to open: real holistic retreats from verified practitioners, with a deposit and direct online payment. Tell us what you're looking for, and at launch we'll suggest retreats chosen for you.
tr.eyebrow: For those who feel the need to pause
tr.title: There's a retreat out there waiting for you
tr.subtitle: The silence of an olive grove at sunset. A circle of real people. Your breath finally slowing down. Somewhere out there is the retreat you have been waiting for: tell us what you seek and we will find it together.
tr.stepsTitle: Not another portal. Someone walking beside you.
tr.s1t: Tell us what you're looking for
tr.s1b: Where you live, what calls you, how far you are willing to go. Thirty seconds, no strings attached.
tr.s2t: Receive a selection chosen just for you
tr.s2b: At launch we won't send you a catalog: we'll suggest the retreats that are right for you, picked by hand.
tr.s3b: You secure your spot with a small deposit and pay directly online, with clear rules. The rest is the journey.
tr.formTitle: Tell us what you're looking for
tr.formBody: Thirty seconds is all it takes. Tell us where you live and what calls you, and at launch you will receive a selection of retreats chosen for you. No email avalanches, just what matters.
tr.peek: Sneak a peek at the retreats preview
tr.b1b: Behind every retreat there's a practitioner with a face, a real place, and reviews from people who've actually been there. You know who you're entrusting yourself to, before you go.
tr.b2t: Your spot is yours, no worries
tr.b2b: A small deposit to secure your spot, direct online payment, the balance later on. No wiring money into the unknown, no surprises.
tr.b3b: Tell us where you live and we'll suggest experiences within easy reach. Sometimes the journey you need is an hour from home.
tr.why: We believe every transformation begins with an encounter: between you, the right people and the right place. Aurya exists to make these encounters happen. One single place, lovingly curated, where you find those who do this work with heart.
tr.directT: Prefer to write to us directly?
